# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secuura/Blockchain s167 (`%2`, 2026-09-10 10:40 → 12:29 AEST — the KS-1041 seat: closed a live exposure, then measured the scope that overturned its own proposal) | **STEP 1 VERIFIED CLOSED ON DEMO, FIVE PRs, FOUR CI-GATE DEFECTS, AND IT CORRECTED WEDNESDAY THREE TIMES AND ITSELF TWICE.** 🔴 **IT REFUSED THE LITERAL INSTRUCTION AND WAS RIGHT: the brief said REMOVE the `location /originate/` block; it CLOSED it instead, returning 404** — because a deletion drops the path through to the SPA catch-all which answers **200 for any path**, so Kam's own criterion would have read **200 before AND after the fix.** *A probe that cannot tell the fixed state from the broken one is a ritual, not a check.* Measured on the demo host **before writing a line.** 🔴 **THEN THE DEPLOY RETURNED FIVE GREEN SIGNALS AND CHANGED NOTHING** — matching sha, `nginx -t` exit 0 BEFORE the reload, reload exit 0, container `Up 2 days (healthy)`, verified rollback — **and it checked the OUTCOME anyway.** Half 1 came back **401 from originate**, and it measured the cause **to the inode**: a single-FILE bind mount binds the **inode**, `cp` wrote a new one, the old was **unlinked** (`find -inum` 0 paths vs a control returning its path). **No host-side write could reach that container.** ✅ **IT STOPPED THERE — a container recreate was outside Kam's ruling, it had a working fix in reach, and it asked instead.** Then on his word it found `up -d --no-build --no-deps` **recreated NOTHING** (compose hashes its own config, blind to a bind-mounted file's content), used `--force-recreate` on that one service, **flagged the intent-over-letter trade rather than burying it**, and noted `docker restart` would have re-served the stale inode — a SECOND green-signals-wrong-file failure. ✅ **STEP 2: IT PRODUCED A SCOPE PROPOSAL, THEN MEASURED THE GAP THAT DESTROYED IT.** It had written *"the header is not the vulnerability; the ungated path to it was"* and told Wednesday **not** to touch `extractTenantContext` — then probed ingress and found **34 containers can forge connector identity direct to `originate:4000` → 200**, four cells with both no-header cells 401 (so it is the headers, not the path) and both gateway cells 401 (so the strip works). **It retracted its own central sentence within twenty minutes of writing it.** 🔑 **AND IT CARRIED THE BOUNDARY AS PRECISELY AS THE FINDING** — not externally reachable (`originate:4000` unpublished; control: nginx-gateway at `0.0.0.0:6882->80/tcp`) — so a successor cannot take the 200 without it. ✅ **MEASURED vs REASONED kept in separate headings, and it REFUSED the cross-tenant JWT probe without a fresh commission.** ✅ **FOUR CI-GATE DEFECTS, none of them a finding in any diff, each proven with a discriminator (identical failures on two unrelated PRs):** the audit-contract step exiting 1 **printing NOTHING** (`bash -e` aborting on an assignment, so every message its author wrote is unreachable) · **two competing npm-audit allow-lists, CI's EMPTY** · a probe **folding stderr into its own verdict** via `2>&1` · and **a security-gates job downloading an UNPINNED package and executing it mid-run.** 🔴 **KS-1076 (Urgent): no Playwright e2e has run on ANY PR since 2026-09-07** — it dies at a static gate before any browser opens, so its red implied tests ran and failed. **File touched by neither PR, proven pre-existing against controls.** | 1 | **1.00** | 1.00 | **Wednesday's completion check: COMPLETE, and it exceeds the commission in five places.** ⚠ **IT CORRECTED WEDNESDAY THREE TIMES, ALL THREE RIGHT:** the `45 startup_failures` figure was **127**
